findings.title: Water now / Save watering hangs forever when the API does not answer (no 10 s timeout)
findings.steps: On /beds, make POST /api/waterings hang (never respond), click 'Water now' for North bed, wait 12 s+.
findings.expected: Request is aborted after 10 s, an error is shown next to the bed and the button becomes usable again.
findings.actual: Button stays on 'Watering…' and disabled indefinitely; no message. useApiClient/$fetch has no timeout.
findings.evidence: After 12 s the North bed button text was 'Watering…' with disabled=true.

findings.title: Watering two beds quickly re-enables the first bed's button while its request is pending, allowing duplicate waterings
findings.steps: Delay POST /api/waterings for bed 1 by 4 s. Click 'Water now' on North bed, then on Shade corner, then click North bed's 'Water now' again.
findings.expected: North bed's button stays disabled until its own request finishes; one watering per click.
findings.actual: A single shared wateringBedId is overwritten by the second bed and cleared by its finally block, so North bed's button is re-enabled mid-request; the second click sends another POST and records a duplicate watering. Notice/error state is also shared, so Shade corner's success message is lost.
findings.evidence: North bed button disabled=false while its first POST was pending; 3 POSTs sent for 2 intended waterings; only 'Watered North bed.' notice displayed.

findings.title: No idempotency on watering create: retry after a timeout/lost response records a second watering
findings.steps: POST a watering; the response is lost; user clicks Water now again.
findings.expected: One watering recorded (idempotency key or dedup).
findings.actual: Each POST inserts a new row; no idempotency key is sent or checked.
findings.evidence: create_watering always INSERTs; frontend sends no key.

findings.title: Recent waterings error on dashboard has no retry
findings.steps: Make GET /api/waterings return 500, navigate to Dashboard via the nav link.
findings.expected: Error message with a Retry button that reloads the list once the server is back.
findings.actual: Only 'Could not load recent waterings.' is shown; no retry control (refresh is not even destructured), user must reload the page.
findings.evidence: Section text: 'Recent waterings / All waterings / Could not load recent waterings.' with no button.

findings.title: Waterings page error state has no retry
findings.steps: Make GET /api/waterings return 500 (HTML body) and open Waterings via the nav link.
findings.actual: 'Could not load waterings.' with no button in main; only workaround is changing the filter or reloading.
findings.evidence: main buttons list was [] in the error state.

findings.title: Bed filter silently shows only 'All beds' when the beds request fails
findings.steps: Make GET /api/beds return 500, navigate to Waterings via the nav link.
findings.expected: An error explains the bed list could not load, with a retry.
findings.actual: The select contains only 'All beds'; no error shown (beds error is ignored), so filtering by bed is impossible with no explanation.
findings.evidence: Filter form text 'Bed / All beds'; no alerts on page.

findings.title: Out-of-range integer ids cause 500 on create, list filter and delete
Recent waterings and Waterings tables overflow at 375 px with a long bed name
findings.steps: Create a bed named 'Raisedbedwithaverylongnamewithoutanyspacesatall🌱x', water it, view / and /waterings at 375 px width.
findings.expected: No horizontal scrolling; long names wrap.
findings.actual: Page scrolls sideways: scrollWidth 546 px on dashboard, 631 px on /waterings (Bed column and Amount/Delete columns pushed off-screen).
findings.evidence: document.documentElement.scrollWidth 546 / 631 vs clientWidth 375; overflowing TD with the bed name.

findings.title: Small litres amounts display as '0 L'
findings.steps: Record a past watering of 0.001 litres (accepted by the form and server, which only require > 0).
findings.expected: Value shown correctly or refused with a reason.
findings.actual: Displayed as '0 L' (formatLitres rounds to 2 decimals); the success notice also says 'Recorded 0 L'.
findings.evidence: Dashboard row showed 'North bed 0 L' for a 0.0001 L watering.

findings.title: Absurd past dates accepted (year 1)
findings.expected: Refused with a reason (no minimum date).
findings.actual: Saved and shown as '1 Jan 1' in lists.
findings.evidence: API returned 201; dashboard shows '1 Jan 1 North bed 1 L'.
